Fee revenue from self-financing students and contract clients is recognised. A signed agreement is the first point where that revenue becomes real.

**Between prospect record and billing.** A qualified Prospect Record becomes a signed **Enrollment Contract or Sales Agreement**, and billing then issues payment obligations. The commitment protects fee revenue recognition, budget commitments, and billing's ability to issue payment obligations. The signed Enrollment Contract or Sales Agreement tells billing what to invoice.

Name: Grant Management
Documentation:
**A call for proposals arrives.** The university screens it and then manages the award through every stage: proposal, signed agreement, spending, delivery, compliance and closeout. This is the part of the institution that keeps externally funded projects usable, recovers sponsor money, and proves the work was done lawfully. When it runs well, staff charged to grants are paid and the university does not return funds it has already received.

**It sits between sponsors and project work.** It depends on clear sponsor calls, accurate expense records and timely audit responses, and it turns those into proposal submissions, signed agreements, invoices, progress reports and compliance reports. A missed audit finding blocks future awards from the same sponsor, so the corrective loop matters as much as the original application.

**The Executed Grant Agreement controls the award.** It exists only after both the institution and the sponsor have signed, and the institution keeps it as the controlling document for everything that follows.

Name: Institutional Advancement
Documentation:
**Private support supplements public funding.** Serbian higher education relies on state-funded places and self-financing tuition, so institutional advancement secures philanthropic support, builds donor relationships, and grows endowed funds. Each incoming pledge or gift is checked against the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection and recorded under the correct university or faculty legal entity. That protects revenue and donor trust across both integrated and federated university forms.

**It feeds a chain of receipts, schedules, and recognition.** Donor prospect lists, gift notifications, and consent records arrive here. When a gift is verified, a pledge signed, or a campaign milestone reached, the domain issues outputs such as gift receipts, pledge payment schedules, and donor acknowledgement letters. Those records keep donors informed and make future outreach lawful and targeted.

**The gift receipt carries the weight.** A verified gift becomes a gift receipt that ties the payment to the specific donor and fund, leaving a traceable record for the institution and the supporter.

Name: Manage Academics
Documentation:
**Before each term starts.** The institution must turn approved study programmes into a workable schedule of courses, instructors, and rooms. Manage Academics carries this from curriculum planning through student assessment and academic support. When it works, every enrolled student follows a validated study path, earns ECTS credits, and receives a recognised qualification.

**It links planning to the records the rest of the institution reads.** This work depends on the Study Programme Proposal, Course Syllabus, Teaching Staff Availability, and Room Inventory. The grades it records and the Transcript of Records it issues keep enrolment verification, tuition billing, and graduation certification running, because those downstream processes read the same student data.

**The Course Catalogue publishes the plan.** It is the official list of available courses for a given academic year, and it is what students check before registration opens.

Name: Manage Students
Documentation:
**From first contact to separation.** A student's administrative lifecycle covers recruitment, admission, enrollment, financial arrangements, housing, records, and billing. Every student on the books is attached to an accredited study programme, holds a lawful Student Record, and receives the services their status carries.

**Accreditation and quota sit upstream.** A Student Record is opened only when NAT has issued a valid Accreditation Decision for the programme. Admissions, enrollment confirmations, financial aid awards, housing assignments, tuition invoices, and transcripts all depend on that central record. When a student is not associated with both an accredited programme and a lawful Student Record, those downstream documents stop.

**The Student Record anchors the rest.** It is the central record, updated when a Personal Data Change Request is verified. When it is accurate, each downstream service proceeds against the same lawful record.

Name: Marketing
Documentation:
**Promotion ties each claim to accreditation.** The marketing function presents accredited study programmes, builds institutional reputation, and generates qualified prospective student demand within state-funded enrolment quotas and the European Higher Education Area. It owns the message that reaches prospective students, parents, employers, and public bodies, and that message must stay in line with the Law on Higher Education and the Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area.

**Every claim traces to official specifications.** The function works from the ministry's Enrolment Quota Decision and the Accredited Study Programme Catalogue with ECTS credit values. Every public claim must be traceable to the official programme specification. Before any public material goes out, it is checked against the accredited programme portfolio and the Law on Higher Education. The check protects against promoting a programme without a valid accreditation decision or misstating its ECTS workload. When that happens, materials are removed and no qualified Lead Record is generated, so the institution cannot fill its state-funded quota.

**Programme Fact Sheet carries the standard.** The Programme Fact Sheet is issued only after a compliance review against accreditation status and ECTS presentation rules. It states the learning outcomes, accreditation status, and workload in ECTS for a study programme, so every public claim can be traced back to the official NAT-accredited programme specification.

Name: Sales
Documentation:
**Prospects arrive from inquiries and campaigns.** The Sales domain turns those prospects into signed revenue agreements for study places, contract education, research services, and other chargeable offerings. In the Serbian and EHEA setting, that means selling nationally accredited programmes to self-financing students and corporate clients within state-set enrolment quotas. The outcome is a signed Sales Agreement or Enrollment Contract valid under the Law on Higher Education and usable for fee collection. When this works, fee revenue from self-financing students and contract clients is recognised, and downstream billing issues payment obligations.

**It depends on accreditation and quotas.** Each saleable programme must hold current NAT accreditation and fit within the ministry-fixed enrolment quota. A programme without current accreditation or with exhausted quota is not sold. The domain builds a valid offer from each Accredited Study Programme record and validates Draft Tuition Fee Schedules against cost and regulatory requirements before use. The signed documents it produces carry the legal signatory of the university or faculty and feed fee collection downstream.

**One quota caps self-financing places.** The ministry-approved **Enrollment Quota** sets the maximum number of sellable places per programme and cycle. A programme that exhausts its quota is not sold, regardless of demand. This protects the institution from committing places it is not authorised to deliver.

Name: Support
Documentation:
**Problems are logged, sorted, and answered.** When a student or staff member hits a broken IT system, a facilities fault, or a question about enrollment or fees, the Support domain takes the report and routes it to the right resolver or knowledge source. Its job is to make sure every Issue Report and Inquiry receives a documented resolution or response. Unresolved blockers are what this domain exists to remove.

**It sits across both central and faculty-level help.** The same type of issue is handled by a central support unit or by a faculty-level office, depending on whether the university is integrated or federated. The domain keeps ownership and escalation paths clear while respecting the legal personality of faculties. That consistency is what lets a student complete enrollment or a staff member access records without knowing who is behind the resolution.

**After a fix, the knowledge is kept.** A **Knowledge Article** captures the solution for reuse, so the next person with the same issue does not wait for diagnosis from scratch. It turns a single fix into institutional memory.

Name: Students
Documentation:
**Institutions sell education to two kinds of students.** Operators offer study programmes to learners who are either state-funded on budget places or self-financing. Both routes bring revenue into the institution.

**The funding status shapes the exchange.** A state-funded budget place means the state pays; self-financing means the student pays directly. That distinction determines how public and private money supports each programme. The funding route that carries public money into enrolment is a **budget place**.

Name: Employers
Documentation:
**Employers buy three things from institutions.** Higher education operators sell graduates, research results, and contract education to employers. These purchases turn academic output into a commercial exchange.

**Employer demand gives this exchange shape.** Institutions sell research results and graduates to employers. That flow links academic work to the labour market. A direct transaction between an institution and a business is the purchase of **research results**.

Name: Ministry responsible for higher education
Documentation:
**The ministry supervises and funds institutions.** The ministry responsible for higher education allocates budget funding, supervises institutions, and purchases education, research and public services through ministry funding. This makes it the main buyer and supervisor in the sector.

**Public funding reaches institutions through this.** The ministry buys capacity on state-funded places, which directs budget funding into institutions. The transaction that turns a policy decision into a funded study place is the purchase of **capacity on state-funded places**.

Name: National Accreditation Body
Documentation:
**Accreditation is the gateway to recognised degrees.** The National Accreditation Body accredits institutions and study programmes. That approval acts as a precondition for enrolling students and issuing recognised degrees.

**Formal records follow each approval.** The body issues Accreditation Certificates and Study Programme Accreditations. The document that unlocks enrolment for a specific programme is a **Study Programme Accreditation**.

Name: Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection
Documentation:
**Personal data handling has an external supervisor.** The Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection oversees personal data processing under the Law on Personal Data Protection. That oversight applies to any processing of personal data in the sector.

**The law defines the boundary.** The Commissioner supervises personal data processing to the standard set by the law. The baseline institutions must meet when processing personal data is the **Law on Personal Data Protection**.

Name: Partner institutions
Documentation:
**Erasmus+ credit mobility connects institutions across borders.** Serbian institutions exchange learning agreements and inter-institutional agreements with foreign partner institutions. These agreements set the terms for mobility.

**Partner institutions formalise the exchange through agreements.** Under Erasmus+ credit mobility, institutions exchange Learning Agreements and Inter-Institutional Agreements. The relationship for a specific mobility arrangement is defined by an **Inter-Institutional Agreement**.

Name: Academic and non-academic staff
Documentation:
**Staff provide what institutions buy.** Academic and non-academic staff supply **teaching, research and administrative inputs** to higher education institutions.

**The operating model records those purchases.** Operators buy those inputs from staff.

Name: Publishers
Documentation:
**Publishers supply the content.** Publishers supply **published content** for teaching and research inputs.

**The operating model shows the purchase.** Operators buy teaching, research and administrative inputs from publishers.

Name: Equipment suppliers
Documentation:
**Institutions buy their equipment.** Equipment suppliers provide **teaching, laboratory and research equipment** used by higher education institutions.

**These purchases appear in the operating model.** Operators buy teaching, research and administrative inputs from equipment suppliers.

Name: Facility providers
Documentation:
**Physical space comes from providers.** Facility providers supply **physical facilities and related services** used by higher education institutions.

**The operating model lists these purchases.** Operators buy teaching, research and administrative inputs from facility providers.

Name: Campaign-to-Profitability
Documentation:
**A new recruitment cycle begins.** Market research is commissioned, bringing in prospective student and competitor data. The stream carries that evidence through to a demonstrated campaign return, ending with a profitability report that shows which programmes and funding types repay marketing spend. Marketing and finance leadership receive a Profitability Report and Campaign Performance Report. The point is to tie spend to enrolment outcomes, so future budget follows evidence.

**Marketing spend needs evidence.** Enrolment conversion data must carry a marketing source code from first contact to enrolment, and campaign budget must still be available during the main recruitment period. When both hold, the stream hands leadership a clear link between spend and enrolled students, and next cycle's budget is allocated on evidence.

**A Profitability Report settles the budget.** It lists which programmes and funding types repay marketing spend.

Name: Prospect-to-Enrollment
Documentation:
**A prospective student submits an inquiry.** The inquiry form or event registration includes recorded consent. The stream carries that contact through recruitment planning, lead qualification, admission, course registration and master record creation. It ends with an Enrollment Confirmation and an active Student Record for a place on an accredited study programme. Admission is protected by two conditions: the programme holds current NAT accreditation, and the prospect has a lawful consent record.

**Accreditation and consent are required.** The stream depends on those conditions before any admission offer is issued. When they hold, the new student record becomes active and downstream academic services begin. This connects recruitment to the institution's academic records.

**An Enrollment Confirmation marks the transition.** It confirms a place on an accredited study programme, turning a prospect into an enrolled student.

Name: Enrollment-to-Graduation
Documentation:
**An enrolled student seeks course advice.** At the start of a term, the student requests guidance on course selection. The stream carries them through advising, registration, assessment and record completion. It ends with a cumulative Student Record, a Transcript of Records and a Diploma Supplement after final assessment. The purpose is to accumulate ECTS credits course by course, so the student graduates.

**Credits depend on assessment evidence.** The stream requires assessment evidence for each course and a path to pass required courses. When those are present, credits accumulate and final records are issued. This protects the student's progression and the integrity of the transcript.

**A Diploma Supplement completes the record.** It is issued after final assessment, alongside the cumulative Student Record and the Transcript of Records.

Name: Curriculum-to-Class-Schedule
Documentation:
**Council approves the course list.** After an accredited curriculum is in place, the academic council approves the course offerings list. The stream turns those approved courses into bookable classroom sessions with reserved teaching spaces and equipment. The aim is to ensure every required course has a qualified instructor and a room before registration opens. Students and staff receive:
- a published Class Schedule
- a Teaching Load Report
- Resource Booking Confirmations

**Scheduling depends on instructors and rooms.** The stream requires a qualified instructor and an available room for each required course. When those are in place, the course is scheduled and students register. This connects curriculum approval to day-to-day teaching operations.

**A published Class Schedule opens registration.** It lists the bookable classroom sessions for the term.

Name: Programme-Proposal-to-Accreditation
Documentation:
**A Study Programme Proposal is submitted.** The responsible academic body puts forward the proposal. The stream moves through curriculum design, internal program evaluation and effectiveness measurement. It produces a Program Evaluation Report and an Accreditation Self-Evaluation Report sufficient for submission to NAT. The point is to prepare accreditation renewal on complete documentation and current standards, protecting the programme's right to enrol students.

**Documentation and standards must be current.** The stream depends on Study Programme Documentation being complete and standards being up to date. When they are, the evaluation reports are ready for NAT and the programme keeps its enrolment rights. This connects proposal to national accreditation.

**Accreditation Self-Evaluation Report goes to NAT.** It is the evidence package prepared for the national accreditation body.

Name: Call-to-Grant-Closeout
Documentation:
**A Call for Proposals opens.** Sponsor guidelines accompany the call. The stream carries the proposal through award, project execution, compliance and billing. It ends with a Final Project Report and a reconciled sponsor payment recorded against the award. The purpose is to close out the project with every expenditure allowable and aligned with the Law on Higher Education, so payment is released.

**Compliance determines final payment.** The stream depends on sponsor terms aligning with the Law on Higher Education and on every expenditure passing review. When those hold, the sponsor releases payment and the institution records it against the award. This protects the institution from having to return funds.

**Final Project Report closes the award.** It accompanies the reconciled sponsor payment.

Name: Donor-Prospect-to-Endowment
Documentation:
**A consented prospect record arrives.** The advancement database receives a new donor prospect with recorded consent, and that entry starts the journey through prospect research, solicitation, gift processing and endowment establishment. The institution is working to turn private support into lasting funds; it does so only when consent is demonstrated at each step and pledge payments are collected.

**The sequence ends with the fund in place.** What began as a record ends as an endowed fund established, gift receipts issued, and an endowment annual report delivered to the donor. If that chain holds, private revenue is protected and endowment growth continues.

**A final report reaches the donor.** The **Endowment Annual Report** is delivered once the fund is established and receipts are issued, giving the donor a clear record of the endowed fund now in place.

Name: Sales-Plan-to-Revenue
Documentation:
**A ministry-approved enrolment quota starts the year.** Sales staff use that quota to plan territory assignment, pricing, lead conversion, channel sales and account renewal. The work turns the annual plan into revenue; it succeeds when every offer is backed by the accredited programme catalogue and current price list, so no invalid offer goes out.

**The journey ends in account review.** From that planning start, the institution produces three finished outcomes:
- a Customer Portfolio Analysis
- renewed contracts
- signed sales orders for self-financing and contract client places
Each signed Enrollment Contract or Sales Agreement reflects a valid, deliverable offer.

**The year ends in a single analysis.** The **Customer Portfolio Analysis** gathers the account-level results into one review that closes the sales cycle.

Name: Issue-Report-to-Resolution
Documentation:
**A report reaches the service desk.** A student or staff member submits an Information Inquiry or Issue Report, and support staff route it to the right resolver. The resolver fixes the underlying problem and updates reusable knowledge, so the next similar report is handled more quickly.

**The work depends on two conditions.** Each report needs enough diagnostic detail, and each resolver needs access to the affected system or Student Record. When those hold, the issue is resolved and the requester is not left blocked.

**The fix is documented once.** The **Resolution Record** records what was fixed and is completed before the Closure Notification goes to the requester, giving both sides a record of what was resolved.

Name: Enrollment-to-Paid-Tuition
Documentation:
**Enrollment Confirmation creates a payment obligation.** For every state-funded or self-financing student, that confirmation starts a journey through aid determination, payor relationships and invoice payment allocation. The institution bills and collects tuition only when payor authorization is present and aid eligibility is resolved.

**The account is settled by a recorded allocation.** Once the Tuition Invoice is issued, payments are matched to that invoice. The journey ends when the student account moves out of unpaid status and the obligation is closed.

**The account closure is recorded.** The **Payment Allocation Record** shows where each payment was applied, closing the obligation that enrollment confirmation opened.
